manifest.note: Copied from the manifest so the build can check itself against it. The manifest is not in this repository; scripts/check-swarm-sdk-pin.js --manifest <path> re-reads the authoritative file when it is available, enforcing the fields that decide which chain this is and only noting drift in the generator's bookkeeping.
